name: ESL lifeline sequence over a shared pinned time axis
author: cp-4895 (WP-6, ADR-0005 D3 §1b row) -- timeline/sequence sub-family, reuses the cp-4892 \foreach generator convention for the lifeline row
description: A parametric \nlifelines-wide row of aligned lifelines (alignment-symmetry) dropping through a shared, pinned time-axis (pinned-axis primitive -- the contract's own timeline example), with a sync-marker at one common barrier depth on every lifeline and two illustrative life-messages crossing between lifelines at their own depths. Realizes the contract §1b timeline/sequence components: time-axis, lifeline, sync-marker, life-message. Colors reuse the ESL domain-semantic scheme (process-accent=lifeline, core-accent=sync-marker, param-accent=life-message, digitaldomain=time-axis neutral structure).

parameters.name: \nlifelines
parameters.meaning: number of lifelines generated in the row

parameters.name: \nevents
parameters.meaning: number of time-axis depth ticks the lifelines drop through

parameters.name: \syncdepth
parameters.meaning: the shared depth every lifeline's sync-marker is placed at

parameters.name: \depthgap
parameters.meaning: vertical gap between successive time-axis depths

parameters.name: \lifelineprefix
parameters.meaning: lifeline head label prefix; rendered as "<prefix><index>"

operations.summary: edit \nlifelines -- the generator re-derives every lifeline node name and position; no coordinate ever needs hand-editing

edit 
events to extend/shorten the time axis and every lifeline's drop; the two illustrative life-messages are guarded to omit themselves if 
lifelines or 
events is too small to place them
edit \syncdepth to move the shared sync-marker row to a different time-axis tick
edit \lifelineprefix for lifeline head text; life-message labels (req/ack) are hand-authored text in the two \draw[lifemsg] calls, not a macro

change the domain-semantic color for a whole role (lifelinehead/lifelinedrop/syncmarker/lifemsg/axisline) in that role's style definition; keep the family assignments (process-accent=lifeline, core-accent=sync-marker, param-accent=life-message, digitaldomain=time-axis) unless a family settled-decisions record overrides it

invariants: a template must not name a semantic component the contract's §1 vocabulary does not define (§1 extensibility rule)
style/color bindings carry their contract §2 token role; a role's color is never swapped for decoration
(seam: no WP-7 family settled-decisions record yet for family 'flow'; family-specific placement/style/semantic invariants project here once it lands)
